target_audio_url.title: Target Audio Url
target_audio_url.description: Optional URL of an audio clip at least 2 seconds long (maximum 15 MB) to pin to the generated soundtrack. Longer clips are trimmed to the requested video duration, keeping the beginning. The original audio replaces the output soundtrack, padded with silence if shorter than the video, without changing playback speed. Exceptionally high sample rates may be resampled to 96 kHz. Accepts an HTTP(S) URL or a base64 data URI.

prompt_expansion_mode.description: How much effort to spend rewriting the prompt before generation. 'disabled' skips prompt expansion. 'balanced' returns in about a second. 'quality' spends up to ~30s on a richer prompt.

readme:
# MiniMax H3 Max Turbo Text to Video

MiniMax H3 Max Turbo, the fastest H3 tier, turns a prompt into a 5–15 second video with native audio.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 50,000 characters. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `21:9` / `16:9` / `4:3` / `1:1` / `3:4` / `9:16` | `16:9` | Output frame shape. |
| `resolution` | `480P` / `768P` / `1080P` | `768P` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `duration` | integer 5–15 | 5 | Output length in seconds. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |
| `target_audio_url` | audio URL | — | Optional audio the clip should follow. |
| `prompt_expansion_mode` | string | `balanced` | `balanced` rewrites the prompt lightly; `quality` expands it more for richer detail. |

## Billing

You pay for new seconds: $0.025 at 480P, $0.04 at 768P, $0.08 at 1080P.

| Output | 480P | 768P | 1080P |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5s (default) | $0.125 | $0.20 | $0.40 |
| 10s | $0.25 | $0.40 | $0.80 |
| 15s | $0.375 | $0.60 | $1.20 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe subject, action, camera, and sound in order.
- Quote dialogue and name the speaker.

## Also on SandBase

Other H3 Max Turbo endpoints: `minimax/h3-max-turbo/image-to-video`, `minimax/h3-max-turbo/video-extend`, `minimax/h3-max/text-to-video` (H3 Max).
